BUILT FOR THE ARENA

Everything a tournament day needs, from registration to the champion screen, in one place.

BRACKETS

Multi-stage formats

Round robin groups into double elimination into a single-elim final. Each stage picks its own scoring. Any combination, familiar if you come from Challonge.

ROLES

Everyone is a player

Judges and organizers play too. Staff roles are per-tournament grants, and nobody ever judges their own match.

VENUE

QR everything

Check-in, deck verification, and battle scoring run off one QR ticket. Works when the venue wifi does not.

RANKING

Live ELO

Every finalized match moves the ladder instantly. Upsets pay more. The leaderboard never sleeps.

DECKS

234-part catalog

Build 3-bey decks from the full Beyblade X catalog, CX lock chips and assist blades included, with real stats and images.

PAYMENTS

Cash-friendly

Free events confirm instantly. Paid events settle in cash at the venue, recorded and audited by staff.

ONE TOURNAMENT · ANY SHAPE

STAGE AFTER STAGE

Organizers chain stages the way their community plays. Standings compute live, top seeds advance automatically.
